browser.iosBrowser: On iPhone and iPad, add NeuralTex to your Home Screen to get background alerts. Until then, use the bell and in-app toasts.
browser.unsupported: This browser does not support background alerts. You will still see in-app notifications.
browser.grantedDesktop: Browser alerts are on when this tab is in the background.
browser.denied: Browser alerts are blocked. Enable them in browser settings or use in-app notifications.
browser.iosPwaPrompt: Turn on alerts for the installed app (Settings → Notifications).
browser.defaultPrompt: Enable alerts to get notified when a pipeline finishes while you are on another tab.

toast.notEnabledDesc: You can still use the notification bell and in-app toasts while using NeuralTex.
